reason: A UL listing number I can check, a full spec sheet for the electrician and photo reviews from real homes take most of the risk out, and free 30-day returns make $249 an easy thing to try. I'd order one before the electrician comes and send it back if the spec sheet or the finish is off.
objection: It's a brand nobody knows, and I can't tell from this whether the lumens, the actual color temperature values and the canopy and wiring details are really on that spec sheet. If I find that out after the electrician has booked the day, I'm stuck.
